description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint class 'OrganizationAPI' for managing organization data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and updating organization information, validation rules, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: OrganizationAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint class for managing organization data, including GET and PUT operations for retrieving and updating organization information.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current organization's general information, returns an Organization entity wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the organization's information with data from the request and returns the updated Organization object wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: saveOrganizationInfo
methods.description: Helper method to read request parameters, populate an Organization object, and save changes via OrganizationService.

methods.description: Lazy loader for the OrganizationService dependency.
